summary: Anthropic announced updates to Claude Fable 5's biology safety classifiers that reduce false-positive routing to a less capable fallback model by about 85% for biology queries, while still blocking dual-use professional biology and drug-development requests.

categories.reason: The update explicitly expands the model's usable assistance for clinical tasks performed by healthcare professionals.
categories.quote: Healthcare professionals will be able to receive more support from Fable 5 on clinical tasks.

practices.reason: Describes the lab's own classifier tuning and jailbreak-robustness testing process, informative but not a transferable instrument for outside teams.
practices.quote: We then developed updated training data for the classifier based on that constitution, and retrained it, and verified the new classifier would still generally trigger for harmful and dual-use research biology content but would now enable a wider range of benign and beneficial uses.

practices.reason: Changes how often user requests are silently rerouted to a different model depending on query content, relevant to anyone building on the platform's routing behavior.
practices.quote: Fable 5 users will now experience many fewer “fallbacks”—where the system switches to a less capable model after they make a biology-related query.
